high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a Wikipedia page titled "Pietà (Michelangelo)." The page provides information about the famous marble sculpture created by Michelangelo Buonarroti. The text describes the sculpture as representing the "Sixth Sorrow" of the Blessed Virgin Mary, depicting Jesus and Mary at Mount Golgotha. It mentions that the sculpture is located in Saint Peter's Basilica, Vatican City, and is considered a key work of Italian Renaissance sculpture, often taken as the start of the High Renaissance. The top part of the image shows a photograph of a cultural event or performance.
